annotations.title: Switch a Meta automated rule on or off

description: ENABLED hands the rule to Meta to run unattended. A rule that can only pause, lower or notify needs confirm:true. A rule that can switch something ON or RAISE a budget/bid needs confirm:true AND confirmScope (the scopeToken from list_meta_ad_rules, computed from the rule as Meta stores it), and is refused if its worst case breaks the ad account's caps (set_meta_ad_rule_limits). Calling without them changes nothing and returns exactly what the rule would do — show the user, get a yes, then confirm. DISABLED is the brake: never gated. The answer is the status read back from Meta. Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_… or the bare number) from list_meta_ads; required — every rule lives on one ad account

confirm.description: true once the user has said yes to exactly what the refusal described

confirmScope.description: the scopeToken the list tool (or the refusal) prints; required with confirm when the rule can raise spend
